Privacy Policy

Last updated: September 2, 2026

Information we collect

This site does not require an account to browse. We may automatically collect limited technical information through standard analytics and hosting tools, such as pages viewed, browser and device type, approximate location, and referral source, including traffic arriving from Pinterest. If you email us, we collect whatever you choose to share, such as your name and email address.

Cookies

This site may use cookies or similar technologies set by hosting and analytics providers to understand how visitors use the site. You can disable cookies through your browser settings; doing so may affect some functionality.

Amazon Associates disclosure

Timeless & Tailored is a participant in the Amazon Services LLC Associates Program, an affiliate advertising program designed to provide a means for sites to earn advertising fees by linking to Amazon.com. As an Amazon Associate, we earn from qualifying purchases at no additional cost to you. Amazon may set its own cookies and collect data according to its own privacy policy when you click through.

Third-party links

This site links out to Amazon and to our Pinterest account. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of those third-party sites and recommend reviewing their policies directly.

How we use information

We use collected information to understand which content resonates with visitors, to maintain and improve the site, and to respond to inquiries sent to us by email. We do not sell personal information to third parties.

Children's privacy

This site is not directed at children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect information from children.

Changes to this policy

We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Changes will be posted on this page with an updated revision date.

Contact us

For privacy questions, collaborations, or affiliate inquiries, reach us at contactimelessandtailored@gmail.com.
